name: METRO:«U vojny ne pionerskoe lico»
source:
The pioneer camp "Zubryonok" is a heavenly vacation spot for teenagers from all over Belarus. At the camp, everyone is surrounded by attention and care, but what if all of this abruptly comes to an end? The pioneers will have to survive because "Zubryonok" will find itself in a "nuclear cauldron". The food supplies will only last for a few weeks, and there will be no clean water or communication. They will have to escape from this hell... Or accept their fate and die. This is an entirely new world, completely unlike the one we are all used to. It is utterly annihilated, starving, and exhausted. Survive or die?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3534307538]Steam[/url]]
